availability.note: Genesis AU Build & Price lists 'Electrified GV 70' (shop/gv70ev); highlights page carries Build & Price and Build and Order CTAs. Spec sheet and GoAuto (21 Jul 2026) both describe a single Signature Performance AWD grade. A stale 'NEW ELECTRIFIED GV70 COMING SOON' register-interest page also exists on the site (2025 update leftover).

listPrice.note: GoAuto 21 Jul 2026: 'the single variant GV70 Electrified, which lists from $132,718 plus on-road costs'; CarsGuide 2026 Electrified Sig. Perf. page shows MSRP $132,718. Held $132,800 was the June 2025 launch price (CarExpert, 'before on-road costs'); the $82 drop matches the LCT reduction from the 1 Jul 2026 fuel-efficient threshold rise to $91,661 (0.33 x ~$274 / 1.1). Genesis's own configurator price could not be read: its pricing API fetch was refused by a permission check.

batteryKwh.note: usable 80.0 kWh; nominal 84.0 kWh on the same page. Genesis AU spec sheet and highlights page print 84 kWh (gross, unlabelled, per Hyundai Group E-GMP convention).

rangeKm.note: 'Range (WLTP) 462km' on the AU spec sheet; AU grade ships on 20-inch wheels, matching EV Database's 462 km (TEH, 20-inch) rather than the 479 km 19-inch figure

consumptionKwhPer100km.note: WLTP combined 200 Wh/km / 20.0 kWh/100km on the AU spec sheet (grid-side, so 15.6% above usable 80 / 462 x 100 = 17.3)

bootLitresSeatsUp.note: 'Cargo area - VDA (minimum / maximum) 503 / 1678L'; 22 L under-bonnet cargo area not added

bootLitresSeatsDown.note: VDA maximum 1,678 L; spec sheet does not state whether to the roof or belt line, same VDA-maximum basis the audi-q6-e-tron and kia-ev5 rows use

warrantyYears.note: 60 months / unlimited km; servicing may be by 'a suitably qualified motor vehicle repairer', so unconditional. HV battery 96 months / 160,000 km.

insuranceAnnual.note: kept; price essentially unchanged ($82). Anchors: audi-q6-e-tron-sq6 3500 at $129,900 (380kW), bmw-ix3-50-xdrive 2900 at $112,500, genesis-gv60-magma-awd 3300 at $130,000

depreciationCurve.note: kept, matching genesis-gv60-magma-awd; steeper than mainstream for thin local volume (about nine retail sites, four states) and a $130k+ luxury EV. Brand inconsistency: genesis-gv60-advanced-rwd uses [1,0.66,0.54,0.45,0.38,0.32]; one Genesis curve still to be chosen.

lowConfidence: genesis-gv70-electrified-signature-performance-awd.listPrice: read from GoAuto (Jul 2026) and CarsGuide MSRP, not Genesis's own configurator (pricing API fetch refused); no Genesis-dated confirmation on the research date
genesis-gv70-electrified-signature-performance-awd.depreciationCurve: judged; Genesis brand currently carries two curves (GV60 Advanced differs)
genesis-gv70-electrified-signature-performance-awd.bootLitresSeatsDown: VDA maximum basis (roof vs belt line) unstated
